rationale.purpose: Dedicated-server-only mincer stone output becomes one cobblestone to close material amplification through native Create fan smelting without touching native merchant offer counts.
rationale.decision_source: Direct user complete economy overhaul2026-10-16 requires preventing repeatable purchase/processing/resale cycles; root inspected exact installed Create6.0.8 fan SMELTING behavior and Farm and Charm mincer recipe.
rationale.user_requested: No repeatable machine/crafting chain should create unlimited Coins; retain unrelated native behavior.
rationale.codex_choices: Fix the source material duplication instead of inventing fuel consumption or increasing coal/charcoal prices. Keep exact native recipe ID/category and all native trade original counts; physical dedicated guard preserves zero SMP gameplay in singleplayer.
